stderr:
Usage: skillos [options] [command]

SkillOS Labs Inc Command Line Interface & Automated MCP Connector

Options:
  -V, --version        output the version number
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  init                 Interactive guided setup wizard for first-time users
  help                 Display detailed help with examples
  install              Auto-configure AI clients (Claude, Antigravity, Cursor,
                       Windsurf, Zed, etc.) with SkillOS Labs Inc MCP
  list                 Fetch and list skills from the live SkillOS Labs Inc
                       registry
  inspect              Inspect the full SDS manifest and component status for a
                       skill by slug
  validate             Check a local SDS YAML or Markdown file against the
                       canonical component, metadata, and tier rules
  validate-deployment  Validate a DCS v1 JSON or YAML document locally; it
                       never issues a certificate
  connectors           Browse the live connector catalog, open dashboard setup,
                       test, or revoke a saved connector credential
  passport             Inspect, verify, and manage decentralized cryptographic
                       Agent Passports
  serve                Start the SkillOS Labs Inc MCP Server runtime locally
                       (defaults to stdio)
  doctor               Diagnose and test the SkillOS Labs Inc MCP Server stdio
                       handshake and detected client installations
  activate             Fetch and print the full SDS v1.1 system prompt for a
                       skill via the SkillOS Labs Inc MCP subsystem

Run skillos help for detailed documentation and examples
